description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Study a structure, vehicle, machine, or construct you can see within 60 feet. You learn the single point at which it fails. Until the end of the encounter, your Strikes against it are critical hits on any successful attack roll, and a creature inside, aboard, or made of it takes a −2 circumstance penalty to AC against you.

rules.label: You have studied this structure's failure point this encounter

cinderfall.incomplete: The crit-upgrade-vs-objects half is confirmed real and matches pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-18/final-shot.json almost exactly (RollOption toggle + AdjustDegreeOfSuccess on selector strike-attack-roll). The separate "-2 circumstance AC to occupants" clause stays unbuilt: no selector reaches a different creature's AC from the attacker's own action, and no companion effect exists to carry it.
